answer: A concrete defense gates every agent through one rate-limited inlet, where it must lock a non-refundable bond to enter. A rotating jury then refracts each identity through a prism of independent signals: funding origin, timing cadence, graph position. Honest agents scatter across the spectrum, but a clone fleet collapses into one tight band and every bond behind it is slashed. No shared haven survives that audit, so faking N identities costs N genuinely distinct funded histories plus N throttled entries, a linear real cost with nothing to amortize.
